questions.question: During a night-time crying episode, at what point would a parent most naturally hold the phone near the cot and let it listen?

options.label: Straight away, before trying anything
options.belief_phrase: right at the start, before anything is tried

options.label: After the first thing they try has not worked
options.belief_phrase: once the first attempt has failed

options.label: After several attempts, when they are out of ideas
Only once the baby has been crying for a long time
